input.name: a-raster-asset-is-sniffed-and-previews-itself
input.covers: Raster dimensions size the flattened page; PNG/JPEG resources become canonical PDF assets with derived previews and metadata.

input.name: supplied-previews-and-sizes
input.covers: An explicit raster size controls its page; supplied preview bytes and MIME type survive while rendering is skipped.

input.name: a-loose-pdf-needs-a-size
input.covers: Current PDFs take their inserted page size without a size hint; a hint cannot override the PDF geometry. Every library is canonical.

input.name: asset-sources-that-are-refused
input.covers: Unknown library, unsupported bytes, malformed source/preview and zero-size raster reject on their exact current channels before opening a document.

input.name: into-an-existing-loose-library
input.covers: Current createAsset queues on an existing canonical library; an empty library id rejects rather than creating an obsolete loose library.

input.name: appends-a-page-to-a-canonical-library
input.covers: Append writes the named page and PieceInfo, extracts/renders it, saves and closes before publishing its descriptor.

input.name: a-supplied-preview-skips-the-render
input.covers: A supplied preview skips the append render and preserves MIME type.

input.name: appends-that-are-refused
input.covers: Multi-page insert, missing layout, PieceInfo refusal and unknown handle close without publishing; raster append is tested independently with a real successful flatten.

input.name: an-unsaved-append-changes-nothing
input.covers: A failed download closes and rolls back descriptors/resources; recovery reopens the unchanged canonical bytes.

input.name: a-save-that-answers-nothing
input.covers: Deliberately malformed missing canonical/extracted bytes are kept separate from valid engine DTOs and cause exact later missing-byte refusals.

input.name: removes-a-canonical-page-first
input.covers: Delete rewrites canonical bytes before descriptor/resource removal; unknown asset is a no-op.

input.name: removing-the-last-page-drops-the-library
input.covers: Current deletion leaves the canonical library and unregistered seed; removing an imported sole page is refused by a conforming engine, preserving all resources.

error.name: EngineError
error.message: a document must keep at least one page

input.name: a-failed-page-delete-keeps-the-asset
input.covers: Refused delete closes without changing descriptor, source or canonical bytes; retry succeeds.

input.name: removals-are-serialized-per-library
input.covers: One library queue waits while another proceeds; queued duplicate removals read current state and do not rewrite twice.

input.name: remove-library
input.covers: Deleting canonical libraries clears all descriptors and resources; unknown and repeated deletes emit no facts.

input.name: an-append-queued-behind-a-removed-library
input.covers: Delete library waits for the earlier page deletion; the later append sees the removed target and rejects.

input.name: a-loose-append-queued-behind-a-removed-library
input.covers: Current raster append uses the canonical queue and rejects after an earlier library deletion; no loose-library replacement exists.

input.name: a-loose-append-finds-its-library-canonical
input.covers: A canonical raster append reads the queue state after the first delete, uses its rewritten bytes and adds a new PDF page.

input.name: a-loose-asset-under-a-canonical-id
input.covers: Preferred library ids cannot replace live canonical ownership: createLibrary allocates a fresh id when the requested id is already taken.

input.name: a-queued-mutation-after-destroy
input.covers: Current queued writes can finish after destruction; instance-closed diagnostics drop state updates while cleanup clears the resource maps.

input.name: create-update-and-delete-libraries
input.covers: Create/update/export/delete canonical libraries, filter kinds, preserve categories, emit facts and isolate a throwing listener.

input.name: library-writes-that-fail
input.covers: Missing canonical bytes refuse updates; invalid raster size rejects before an open; required metadata Unsupported and failed saves close with no new library.

input.name: import-a-registered-library
input.covers: Registered page keys determine identifiers/labels in page order; title/kind/locale and page metadata survive, hidden registration warns once.

input.name: registry-refusals
input.covers: Empty/duplicate identifiers and a deliberately malformed absent registry refuse exactly; custom library kind survives successful recovery.

input.name: marks-become-assets
input.covers: Ink/free-text marks create typed annotations on scratch pages, export their appearance, then append PDF pages; image and PDF marks use current source bytes.

input.name: marks-that-are-refused
input.covers: Conflicting/missing source, malformed colors, empty ink, missing PDF pages and invalid identifiers refuse without adding assets; every scratch/source document closes.

input.name: an-ink-mark-with-defaults
input.covers: Ink defaults reach the real engine draft; an empty scratch document closes and rejects without creating a library.

input.name: edit-move-and-copy-assets
input.covers: Asset updates preserve identity and merge metadata; duplicate/move use derived new ids and preserve bytes, previews and metadata; same-library move is an identity read.

input.name: edits-queued-behind-removals
input.covers: Asset and library edits queued after their deletions reject not-found when their queue turn arrives.

input.name: copies-carry-their-metadata
input.covers: Copies and cross-library moves retain subject/categories/preview and remove the original only after the new asset commits.

input.name: raster-pages-that-fail
input.covers: A valid current unchanged flatten status is refused by stamp; required engine flatten Unsupported also closes with no asset, and a later successful raster append recovers.

input.name: an-asset-from-annotations
input.covers: Current extraction resolves the real page and download grant before exporting selected appearances; invalid source/mark, closed document and refused egress cannot add assets.

input.name: rendered-previews
input.covers: Preview widths cache independently, failure reports and falls back, empty source page returns null; deleting the asset clears its renders.

input.name: place-without-the-pointer
input.covers: Programmatic placement uses current annotation operations/resources; per-page failure appears in the batch and successful later placement recovers.

input.name: the-armed-asset
input.covers: Armed read follows the shipping annotation stamp tool; tool changes disarm once and permission getters resolve explicit/active/closed documents.

input.name: can-place-without-a-document
input.covers: No active document means placement and annotation extraction grants are false.

input.name: restore-stored-libraries
input.covers: Stored libraries import file-owned ids; invalid stored bytes warn and are skipped.

input.name: a-store-that-cannot-list
input.covers: A store list rejection rejects restore unchanged.

input.name: persist-library-changes
input.covers: Current persistence saves after each burst, deletes removed libraries, honors exclusions and stops observing after unsubscribe; debounce timers were removed.

input.name: stop-flushes-a-write-still-pending-behind-another
input.covers: Current unsubscribe lets already requested work finish; it prevents later library changes from being persisted.

input.name: persistence-failures-are-reported
input.covers: Failed store put/delete warn with exact library id; subsequent work remains live.
